title: Utilized: Magnets and Paxels
description: Adds magnets and paxels of multiple tiers - Peak efficiency
body:
![Utilized: Magnets and paxels](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/41bff89b40bcc4642281a7ab3640631e920d64a0_0.webp)

This mod Adds multiple magnets and paxels to increase utility. Magnets can be enabled and disabled using a key bind and they are equiped in the curious belt slot. Paxels are a combination of a pickaxe, axe, hoe, and shovel, with the trade off of being ever so slightly slower. 

**Paxels for all core tiers:**
- Wooden, Stone, Iron, Golden, Diamond, Netherite
**Magnets for all advanced tiers:**
- Iron, Gold, Diamond, Netherite
  - Pulls nearby dropped items toward the player
  - Toggleable with F6
  - Works when held and supports Curios belt slot
Magnetite Scrap found in structure loot from:
◦ Abandoned Mineshaft
◦ Desert Pyramid
◦ Jungle Temple
◦ Shipwreck (supply, treasure, map)
◦ Dungeon chests
